description: Create, write, rename, delete, move or copy a gameserver file or folder. move/copy put entries into an existing destination folder and never overwrite. Destructive actions (write, rename, delete, move) require confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

destination.description: move/copy: existing folder the entries go into, keeping their names. Nothing is overwritten: a taken name or a missing folder refuses the request.

expectedRevision.description: `revision` returned when the file was read. With action `write` the write is refused (409 file_changed) when the file changed since; re-read and retry.

path.description: File or folder to act on (required except for move/copy given `paths`). For move/copy: the single entry to transfer.

paths.description: move/copy: several entries to transfer at once (overrides path).

scope.description: Without scope paths start at the server root (as `list_gameserver_files` without scope shows them); `config`/`active` resolve paths from the game data root; `savegame` additionally restricts to savegame paths. Read and write a file with the same scope.

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: mutate_gameserver_file
title: Edit Game Server File
